item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01945","case1_error":"Omits the primer’s 20% discount, charging full price.","case2_error":"Uses the boots’ 10% discount amount as their purchase price.","reason":"Ignoring a discount differs from substituting the discount amount for the discounted price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01946","case1_error":"Divides capital by acquisition cost per egg instead of the stated selling price.","case2_error":"Correctly finds 10 cakes remaining, then reports 50 already baked as the number still needed.","reason":"The first uses the wrong rate to calculate recovery; the second answers the complementary quantity after correctly computing the requested remainder.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01947","case1_error":"Labels 15 training days per stage as 15 weeks, omitting division by five; stage descriptions also contradict their thresholds.","case2_error":"Places the second five chips on a separate day, delaying the daily ten-chip schedule by one day.","reason":"The first fails to convert training days into weeks; the second incorrectly assigns events to days.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01948","case1_error":"Counts the two mother lambs again even though they are included in the original six.","case2_error":"Applies the price per dozen directly to individual eggs, omitting conversion from eggs to dozens.","reason":"Double-counting existing animals differs from failing to convert units before applying a rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01949","case1_error":"Doubles the second country’s stay to obtain the third’s, instead of doubling the first country’s stay for both.","case2_error":"Counts five family members instead of four, using an incorrect divisor for equal sharing.","reason":"Using the wrong baseline for a comparison differs from miscounting the people sharing the total.","judgment":"different"}]}
